headline: Monitor and control an Ecoforest heater
intro: Connect an Ecoforest device on your local network with its host address and login credentials. Home Assistant polls the device every 30 seconds, exposing operating readings and controls for its power and on/off state.
highlights: Track environment temperature, operating status, and alarm state, with additional readings for temperatures, pressure, working hours, and airflow
Switch the device on or off and set its power level from 1 to 9
Home Assistant identifies the configured device by its serial number and refreshes its data every 30 seconds

flow.title: From local device to controls
stages: Enter the device host and login credentials
Monitor readings and adjust power or on/off state
